ratings.note: V uses contrast pairs and own-sentence tasks but accepts a weak rule restatement. W gives answer after repeated hint and is drill-only.
W models steps, corrects a wrong rule, adds production. V explains clearly but gives answers twice and ends on new items.
V adds sentence-writing and accepts one-word answers to rewrite tasks. W explains Arabic transfer well but reveals answer and ends on new item.
V's register and tasks far exceed learner level (neither/nor, head nouns). W targets the Arabic be-drop clearly but gives the answer.
V uses contrast pairs, addresses missing article in production. W covers 'the' too but supplies answers and is drill-only.
W models a strategy, targets the zero-article error in production. V is a correct but repetitive drill with no learner errors addressed.
V uses contrast pairs and catches missing article in production. W explains 'the' well but gives the umbrella answer and only drills.
V targets the zero-article error and elicits a rule. W is clear and protected but purely gap-fill drill with no consolidation.
V models thinking and fixes the missing article in production, though accepts one-word rewrites. W repeats the same easy items.
W extends to -es and -ies spelling with good targeted hints. V never resolves the learner's wrong rule belief before moving on.
